proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Our Grandin shed sat at the bottom of a yard you can barely mow. They carried it up in pieces, wall by wall, to the trailer on the street. We got about 160 square feet of yard back for the kids.
reviews.name: Amanda C.

reviews.text: The deck off the back of our house was fourteen feet up on the low side. They took it down from the top, rail first, with a second person below the whole time. The footings came out too.
reviews.name: Bill F.

reviews.text: Leaning one-car garage on a Raleigh Court alley. They got the permit, had the power line dropped, and took it down over two days. The slab came out and now it parks two cars.
reviews.name: Nora P.

reviews.text: Two metal carports and a rusted playset at my mother's place. One morning, one trailer, and they raked the gravel back over where the carports had stood.
reviews.name: Earl M.

reviews.text: The railroad-tie steps down the side of the house were rotten and wobbly. They pulled them out and graded the slope so the stone mason could start the next week.
reviews.name: Tina G.

reviews.text: The pool came out of our backyard in a day. They spread topsoil and straw where the sand had been, and by May you couldn't find the circle anymore.
reviews.name: Josh R.

proof.guarantee: We leave the ground graded and seeded or strawed, and we come back if it washes out the first month.
